blocks.title: Every experiment, every identity model
blocks.sub: ✓ held · ~ qualified (held within a stated bound) · ✕ broken. One mark per scenario; select a scenario on the Scenarios page for its detail.

blocks.title: How a scenario's outcome is decided
blocks.text: Held means the identity property the scenario tests held. Qualified means it held only within a stated bound, such as a credential's lifetime. Broken means the identity model lost it: the anti-pattern scenarios exist to show exactly that. Outcomes are read from the platform's audit record and each tool's own log. Separately, the run's own checks confirm each scenario behaved as expected: 31 of 31 did.
